sv.title: Därför hyllas Alexander Skarsgårds stil på röda mattan
sv.summary: Kilt, transparenta skor och glittrig Dior-topp. Med sina sprakande outfits har bioaktuella Alexander Skarsgård blivit ett självklart blickfång på röda mattan. I pressen och i sociala medier hyllas den svenska filmstjärnan, men vad är det som ligger bakom hans looks? DN:s Tara Moshizi reder ut.

en.title: Why Alexander Skarsgård's style is being praised on the red carpet
en.summary: Kilt, transparent shoes and a sparkly Dior top. With his sparkling outfits, currently box-office-active Alexander Skarsgård has become an obvious eye-catcher on the red carpet. In the press and on social media the Swedish film star is being praised, but what lies behind his looks? DN's Tara Moshizi explains.
